title: The Ironclad
description: A living fortress of the Shield Wall, sworn to hold the line against the encroaching Veil at any cost.
backstory: Raised in the shadow of the Great Breach, Bastion was forged in the fire of relentless defensive campaigns. They believe that a single unwavering shield can be the difference between a city's survival and its hollowing. Speaks in short, precise sentences, viewing words as resources to be conserved like energy in a siege.
synergy_explanation: Ironjaw's IRON brand perfectly complements Bastion's IRONBOUND path. Together they form an unbreakable defensive wall.
combat_description: Taunt and damage redirection, damage reduction abilities, shield bash stuns, party-wide defense buffs.

title: The Beast Hunter
description: A primal predator who hunts the corrupted with savage precision and tactical bloodlust.
backstory: Born to nomadic frontiersmen, Rend learned early that the only way to survive the Ravaged biomes is to become the apex predator. Their scars are a map of victories against impossible odds. They don't just kill corruption; they hunt it with a focused, predatory silence.
synergy_explanation: Mawling's SAVAGE brand resonates with Rend's FANGBORN path. Its relentless hunger mirrors Rend's predatory instincts.
combat_description: Bleed-focused attacks, high crit rate, execute abilities on low HP targets. Aggressive front-line berserker.

title: The Soul Weaver
description: An ethereal healer who balances the scales of life by siphoning vitality from the corrupted to mend the broken.
backstory: Marrow's touch was once a curse, a wasting disease that drained the life from everything around them. Through intense discipline, they learned to weave this drain into a gift, healing the sick by redistributing the life-force of the Veil's own monsters. They move with a haunting grace, forever mindful of the void within.
synergy_explanation: Hollow's VOID brand perfectly aligns with Marrow's VOIDTOUCHED path. Its ethereal nature complements Marrow's drain healing abilities.
combat_description: Drain healing - damage enemies to heal allies. Life transfer abilities, self-sacrifice heals, debuff enemies to strengthen party.

title: The Void Walker
description: A reality-bending illusionist who manipulates the Veil's energy to fracture the minds of their enemies.
backstory: No one knows where Mirage originated, only that they appeared when the Veil was thinnest. They see the world as a series of shifting silhouettes, a grand illusion they can rewrite at will. Their humor is as sharp as their illusions are terrifying, and their presence often leaves a lingering sense of unreality.
synergy_explanation: Flicker's SURGE brand harmonizes with Mirage's UNCHAINED path. Its chaotic energy amplifies Mirage's reality-bending abilities.
combat_description: Fear and confusion infliction, accuracy debuffs causing enemies to miss from terror, illusory clones and misdirection, mental damage abilities.
